# anthropic_skill (Data Source)

Reads one skill and its latest version.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Anthropic-published skills are addressed by name.
data "anthropic_skill" "xlsx" {
  id = "xlsx"
}

output "xlsx_latest_version" {
  value = data.anthropic_skill.xlsx.latest_version_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Skill id (`skill_...`) or an Anthropic skill name such as `xlsx`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `display_name` (String) Display label.
- `latest_version_description` (String) Description of the latest version.
- `latest_version_id` (String) Newest version id (what `latest` resolves to).
- `latest_version_name` (String) Slug of the latest version.
- `source_type` (String) `custom`, `anthropic`, `anthropic_example` or `plugin`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
